evidence.note: Opaque white 'Capture the flag' card with soft drop shadow over a blurred timeline and diagram; the blurred content stays recognisable as text rows and the servers panel.
Two shadowed cards side by side over blurred context; cards are crisp and clearly in front, the timeline and 'Agent Run' legend still recognisable under the blur.
Insight card floats bottom-right with shadow; timeline, servers panel, node fan and 'Package mirror' are blurred yet their shapes and labels remain readable as context; title stays sharp.
Unblurred steps use shadowed quote cards placed in empty right-hand space, not over the diagram, so no tangle arises.

rationale: Overlay steps apply a moderate blur plus a soft shadow on opaque cards, so the overlay is unmistakably the focus while the timeline and diagram beneath remain recognisable. Non-overlay quote cards sit in free space with a light shadow and do not compete with the diagram. This matches the pass descriptor and the reference anchor of an insight floating over softened content.
